# Needle-in-haystack retrieval

Finding the *specific items that belong to you* inside an overwhelming pool, using a distinctive key (a number, a tag, a fingerprint) to collapse the set.

**Test:** is the core job "locate my/the relevant few in a huge undifferentiated pile via a key"?

Related to but distinct from [[high-signal-filter]]: filtering surfaces *quality*; retrieval surfaces *the specific matches you're looking for*.
